name: Verify portable canonical CLI
command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/.gaia-worktrees/yggdrasil-iv-canonical-cli"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 96d3299951a6dcd5969f11c78396f2a4d7983957
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
PYTHONPATH=src PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_canonical_transaction.py tests/test_canonical_cli.py tests/test_canonical_guard_regressions.py tests/test_canonical_platform.py tests/test_evidence_lifecycle.py tests/test_dev_evidence.py tests/test_curation_authority_map.py
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 96d3299951a6dcd5969f11c78396f2a4d7983957
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
